about: The attendance processor's Apex as we deployed it: tools/auto_sync.py compares each run's read of these components with these digests (glow/salesforce.py apex_attention; docs/RUNBOOK.md, "Attendance processor watch"). sha256 of the body, CRLF -> LF, trimmed (apex_fingerprint), written in groups of 8 hex digits: 64 in a row is what scripts/check_secrets.py refuses as a secret.
recorded: 2026-11-20, ticket #242. The two classes from the retrieve after deploy 0AfRP000002kdV30AI (2026-11-19 14:39:11 UTC, ticket #238; equal to the build); the trigger from that day's retrieve before it (not in that deploy nor in the 2026-10-26 release; live since 2026-10-24).
refresh: After any deploy of ours that changes one of these: retrieve the deployed component (VPN off), then, in the repository root, python3 -c 'import sys; from glow.salesforce import apex_fingerprint as f; d = f(open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8").read()); print(*(d[i:i + 8] for i in range(0, 64, 8)))' <file>; put the digest here, update `recorded`, and commit it with the deploy's plan.
